title: LED Inspection - Scratches Detection on Teron SL650
subtitle: Pre-Diffusion Quality Validation for 7nm Node Manufacturing
author: James Rodriguez

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the Teron SL650 system to detect and classify Scratches defects during pre-diffusion inspection at the 7nm technology node. The test is conducted at Milpitas Fab B to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 300mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Scratches defects that are critical to yield at the 7nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the Teron SL650 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: Teron SL650
- Inspection Type: LED Inspection
- Target Defect: Scratches
- Process Step: Pre-Diffusion
- Wafer Size: 300mm
- Technology Node: 7nm
- Fab Location: Milpitas Fab B

This test case applies to all Teron SL650 systems deployed at Milpitas Fab B for pre-diffusion monitoring in the 7nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: Teron SL650
Software Version: v13.3.367
Recipe: LED_INSPECTION_7nm_PRE_DIFFUSION
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: Medium (199 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.25μm
Edge Exclusion: 5mm
Sampling Plan: Full wafer sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the Teron SL650 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'LED Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Scratches defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 7nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 95 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 92% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±1.0% for LED Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.93 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-05-29
Wafers Tested: 38
Total Defects Found: 3152
Defect Density: 445.92 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 0.6%
Capture Rate: 90.9%
Test Duration: 178 minutes
System Uptime: 97.8%

Result Classification: FAIL
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Teron SL650 demonstrated below-target performance in detecting Scratches at the 7nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) No significant drift was observed during the test duration.

e) The defect review station correlation was within specification.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Re-tune detection algorithm thresholds for Scratches at 7nm node.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Escalate to R&D for algorithm enhancement if re-tuning does not resolve sensitivity gap.
